profile_text.body:
InVideo is a video creation platform accessible at invideo.io. The company offers an AI-powered tool, also called InVideo, that allows users to create and edit videos through a conversational or descriptive interface rather than manual editing workflows.

The platform's current offering centers on a product the company calls Agent Two, which the site describes as enabling users to create and edit AI videos without manual prompt engineering. The site notes that Agent Two stores a project's full context in long-term memory so that clips remain consistent across a session, and that users can describe a scene in plain language while the agent selects an AI model and writes the technical prompt for each shot. The company describes itself as removing the need for users to act as "AI architects."

No litigation, patent filings, SEC records, or MCP server registrations are present in the available data for InVideo.
